scope: documentation evidence closure only; M13 variants remain failed; no human approval

argv:
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess
r=Path.cwd();h=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest();s=json.loads((r/'.runtime/preservation.json').read_text());raw=r/'wiki-project/raw'
for p,v in {**s['nonWikiSha256'],**s['oldRawSha256']}.items():assert h((r/p).read_bytes())==v,p
assert h((r/'wiki-project/log.md').read_bytes()[:s['logPrefixBytes']])==s['logPrefixSha256']
for name in ['C集成-迁移方案执行与联合验收','C集成候选-依赖与非作者签认','C04-收口签认']:assert 'status: active' in (r/'wiki-project/wiki/tasks'/(name+'.md')).read_text()
a=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-third-intake.json').read_text());n=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-third-native.json').read_text());m=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-third-m13-original.json').read_text());v=json.loads((raw/'c-a-lineage-third-m13-variants.json').read_text())
assert a['ACommit']=='65885ff472acee4cedb3b0c17e7c850f30f98d91' and a['sourceAuditSummary']=={'nonWikiFiles':175,'allMatchFixedGitBlob':True}
assert n['summary']['passed']==12 and m['summary']['passed']==4 and len(v['summary']['failed'])==5
assert all(c['control']['guardRejectedOperation'] and c['migrationError'] and c['identifyError'] and c['before']==c['after'] for c in m['cases'])
assert all(c['control']['guardRejectedOperation'] and c['identifyError'] is None and c['migrationError'] is None and c['behaviorError'] is None and c['after']['version']==8 for c in v['cases'])
assert v['cases'][0]['behavior']['deleted'] and v['cases'][1]['behavior']['sameAttemptPreparedRows']==2 and v['cases'][2]['behavior']['sameAttemptPreparedRows']==2 and v['cases'][3]['behavior']['deleted'] and v['cases'][4]['behavior']['zeroAttemptRows']==1
for key,cmd in a['actualCommands'].items():
 assert cmd['exitCode']==(1 if key=='M13Variants' else 0),key
 for k in ['stdout','stderr','output']:
  if k in cmd:assert h(cmd[k].encode())==cmd[k+'Sha256'],key
assert '45 passed (45)' in a['actualCommands']['infrastructure']['stdout'] and '35 passed (35)' in a['actualCommands']['contracts']['stdout']
assert a['sqlFingerprintsMatchPriorFixedCAndB'] and a['authorProbeComparison']['structuredResultsMatchFixedAuthorRecord']
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','codex/c-a-lineage-revalidation']).decode().strip()=='20891fb8e8af8f05d68016dbc514c17cdf481fec'
assert 'X05～X09失败' in (r/'wiki-project/wiki/C迁移联合验证用例.md').read_text()
print(json.dumps({'status':'passed','nonWikiPreserved':len(s['nonWikiSha256']),'oldRawPreserved':len(s['oldRawSha256']),'logPrefixBytes':s['logPrefixBytes'],'oldM13ClosedAtNewAOnly':True,'fiveVariantsRemainFailed':True,'AW08BehaviorResolvedBConfirmationPending':True,'humanTasksActive':True,'previousCBranchUnchanged':True}))
